text:
deploy-bot: Release 2026.03.21 build-7392 deployed to eu-west1. Starting post-deploy smoke for embed and gen routes. Traffic switch scheduled in 5m unless hold requested.

alex: Saw a tail-p95 bump on the embed synths during initial samples — 420ms p95, baseline ~160ms. Not huge but trending. Can someone validate KV warmup coverage? :eyes:

maria: I'm pulling the prefill logs now. Looks like ~2% of prefill tasks exited early with timeout. `prefill-worker` shows `ERR_TIMEOUT 120s` at the end of some batches.

jia: Telemetry also shows sampler tagging missing for a subset of synths — the probe_id tag absent for ~18k events (2.1%). Means they didn't get prefix cache hint.

alex: Ok, two things: (1) hold traffic switch for now, (2) extend warmup window + rerun targeted prefill for embed route. @deploy-bot can you pause the final cutover?

deploy-bot: Traffic switch paused by request. Hold window set to 10m. Reason: smoke anomaly (embed p95).

oncall: I'll kick a targeted prefill replay for eu-west1 embed route with higher concurrency and extended timeouts. Command I'm running: `./tools/prefill --region=eu-west1 --route=embed --concurrency=4 --timeout=300`

maria: Good. Also bumping the prefill retry to 3 for this job in the run config (we saw transient S3 latency on a couple objects). Patch applied to job definition.

jia: Running a quick resample of synths after replay — initial pass looks better: p95 down to ~180ms for re-run traffic. Still seeing a thin tail for seq>512.

alex: If the re-run holds p95 under 220ms and no increase in 5xx, we can do a gradual cutover (10% -> 50% -> 100%) with a 3-min observation window per step. If not, pin to build-7389 and rollback.

oncall: Aggregated metrics at 1m: embed p95 = 185ms, 5xx = 0.04% (stable). Prefill job finished successfully.

maria: Confirmed prefill job logs: all worker shards completed, no ERR_TIMEOUTs. Added a short postjob validation that scans sample keys to ensure cache hit rates > 90%.

alex: Sounds good. Proceed with phased cutover per plan. @deploy-bot start gradual switch (10%) and run synthetic smoke at each step.

deploy-bot: Initiating phased cutover: step1=10% -> wait 180s. Will post updates.

oncall: After 10% step: p95=190ms, 5xx unchanged, no error spikes. Rolling to 50%.
jia: After 50% step: p95=200ms, tail for long seqs still slightly elevated but within SLO slack. No action required now.
maria: Adding a follow-up issue to adjust sampler tagging to avoid missing probe_id in future. Will include a quick unit test for the sampler pipeline.
alex: Great. Leaving note in release notes: "embed route prefill gap discovered and corrected; warmup window increased for eu-west1; phased cutover executed."

deploy-bot: Cutover complete to 100% for build-7392. Final smoke: embed p95=195ms, gen p95 stable. No rollback required. :tada:

alex: Thanks team, closing the hold. Filing a short postmortem blurb for release notes and linking the prefill job id: `prefill-20260321-7392`.
